description:
Route the test fixture `declaration_dir` through the canonical relative-path validator, closing the round-2 `one-form-convergence` checkpoint finding.

## Background

- `declaration_dir` (`crates/jit/src/test_utils.rs`) validates each worktree-relative fixture path with `Path::components()`, accepting only `Normal` and `CurDir` components. On unix it accepts `./a`, `a//b` and `a:b`, which `RootRelativePath::parse` (`crates/jit/src/domain/relative_path.rs`) rejects.
- `RootRelativePath::parse` is the one safe-relative-path validator; `profile/package.rs` already delegates to it and requires a `Descendant`.
- Epic criterion: `b697a3f7` REQ-20 (safe relative paths, with one validator); story `dfb2f10d` REQ-02. Sol checkpoint review round 2, finding 1.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `declaration_dir` accepts a path only when `RootRelativePath::parse` returns a `Descendant`, and refuses every other path before writing anything.
- [hard] REQ-02: No code under `crates/` other than `RootRelativePath::parse` decides whether a relative path input is safe by inspecting its components; normalizers that resolve `.` and `..` in absolute or link paths are outside this criterion.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every existing `declaration_dir` caller still passes, with any fixture path that used a now-refused spelling rewritten in canonical form.


## Deviations

- Behaviour change, approved by the invoker (just-in-time-d5, 2026-11-08): symlink-resolved reads, git control-directory remainders, asset links and external stage paths now go through `RootRelativePath::parse`, which is stricter than the component checks it replaces, so paths containing `:`, `\` or control characters are refused there. Root-relative asset links that climb above the root are refused, where they were clamped before.
- Scope, approved by the invoker: rework 1 also converged `document/assets.rs` (substring `..` counting replaced by `RootRelativePath::resolve_link`, deleting the now-unused `normalize_path`), `storage/external_publish.rs` stage helpers, and `open_capability_parent` / `open_descendant_dir_nofollow`, which now take `&RootRelativePath`.
title: Test declaration fixtures validate paths through the canonical validator
